reviews.text:
The negative reviews were starting to worry me but I can honestly say it was great 
1 apartment was spotless a/c worked almost everything was there that you needed (a floor brush would be a benefit)
2 walk to main areas is less than a leisurely 10 minutes at the furthest apartment everything is well lit at night
3 family areas are good, the larger 2 pools could be a few degrees warmer (they are freezing cold) kids pools are warm water
4 bus book the day before 30 minutes into town
5 staff are very helpful, those that put on the entertainment day and night are very good at their jobs (they have many)
If you're looking for wild nightlife then no this is not the place you're looking for but for families with multi age/generations its very good

reviews.text:
My son and I booked this as a last minute trip for my birthday. On arrival I was worried the resort was too remote and my 19 year old would be bored as the nearest town was 30minutes away but I was wrong. There was something for all ages. The entertainment is aimed at young family but we enjoyed it especially the big show on Sunday evening. The villa are clean, spacious and well equipped. All the staff from reception, bar and cleaners were friendly, helpful and work extremely hard to maintain a high standard in the resort. There are several activities to keep you entertained during the day/night. We were self catering and the shop in the resort is very expensive and does not have a good range but we used the free bus to town and then paid €28 euros for taxi back and purchased our groceries in the dino supermarket. We used the feee bus to Corralejo and spent a day there beside the beach on a different occasion. There is cleaning product, and equipment in the villa so there is no reason for the villa to be left messy and refund not refunded so don’t understand why people are complaining about this. I will most definitely go back to this resort but I think I would go all inclusive. We had a late flight so we paid extra so we could have a late check out which was a great additional extra. 
I did not mention to staff it was my birthday but they surprised me with a card and a voucher for a free cocktail, this small gesture really made me smile and was a lovely surprise. We paid a taxi into town for birthday drinks but we actually preferred the hotel entertainment than town. The hotel lobby is nicely decorated with ample seating areas, pool tables and a good choice of drinks at the bar.

reviews.text:
Firstly, the bad reviews below are so inaccurate, bar the pavements but its understandable as its so windy all the time. 

I just got back with my 3 kids and mrs, and had the best time. The staff from the gardeners, to the entertainers, to the cleaners, are so friendly and make you feel welcome. Endless energy. See them in the morning looking after the kids and in the evening entertaining the adults. All you look for in a holiday really.

Its the perfect place if you dont want to leave the resort. However you get a bus twice a day, it returns earlier but its only a 30 euro cab back. 

One thing for me as its my profession, the food could be better, however thats just me being a d*ck chef. I still ate well, but would of preferred better fish dishes, as i think mussels, monkfish, and defo calamari shouldn't be left under hot lamps. 

This place will always have a place in my heart as it was my first ever holiday with all 3 of my kids, and will 100% be returning.

reviews.text: Just arrived home this evening, we stayed bed and breakfast we have had a fantastic time and the place is lovely! Couldn’t fault the food. The villas are excellent and the free bus service is great - we used this to go into Corralejo we visited the sand dunes and the beautiful beaches, then stoped off at the supermarket and the bus stop is right outside to go back to the hotel,I can’t fault the place I’d 100% go back. I paid the €200 deposit and now it’s after midnight it has gone straight back into my account no problem. I’m not sure why people moan as the weather/ facility's excellent, pools loungers & staff all fantastic, polite and helpful. The place is lovely and clean What more can you ask for, Thankyou so much for an unforgettable holiday 🥰
